chunks.text: In this podcast, we speak very slowly.
Yazd is full of history and desert life.
Iran is a country in western Asia.
Yazd is in the center of Iran.
It is in a desert area.
There are no seas near Yazd.
The city is surrounded by sand.
Because of this, people in Yazd learn to live with little water.
In summer it is very hot.
In winter, it can be cold at night.
Yazd is one of the oldest cities in Iran.
People lived here many centuries ago.
The city was on old trade routes.
Houses are made of mud bricks.
These houses keep the air cool.
In Persian, they are called badgers.
They bring cool air into houses.
They help people survive the heat.
These towers are smart and beautiful.
The old city of Yazd has narrow streets.
The colors are soft and earthy.
It feels like the past is alive.
Yazd is important for Zoroastrian culture.
There are fire temples in Yazd.
Daily life in Yazd is simple.
People use rice, bread and vegetables.
At night, the sky is clear.
Yazd is a city of desert, wind, history and quiet life.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
See you in the next episode.
